speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are out before dinner, and you are playing at two. Leave the desk as you mean to find it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have an errand at Holborn. I will be back to eat. The leaf on the desk is not to be sent.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I do not read it. I dust round it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dust round it. The loaf will keep. I am not asking it to grow.
